description:
Add a feature idea or task in the Cherry Notes iOS app (Android coming soon) and it is waiting for your AI agent before you are back at your desk. Connect ChatGPT to Cherry Notes and it can show your list, pick an item to work on, and mark it done when finished.

Your agent can read, pick, and complete items. Creating and editing stays in the app on your phone, so the list is always yours.
